full_judgment: 10. In the decision in the case of Wahidul Haque vs Bangladesh reported in 54 DLR 165 adverted to by Mr AM Amin Uddin, it appears that the High Court Division had to pass a specific direction upon the respondents to mutate the name of the petitioner in the concerned record of rights within a specific time-frame of 60(sixty) days in order to implement the earlier judgment passed in another Writ Petition filed by the writ-petitioner in respect of the self-same property. Following the decision in that case, we in the facts and circumstances of the present case, are inclined to make a direction upon the respondent No. 1 to deliver the vacant possession of the case property to the petitioners within a specific time-frame. The Rule, therefore, succeeds.
